summary: Verified THE FILMOGRAPHY section + end-credits ContactFooter end-to-end on preview URL. Backend /api/filmography returns the expected 3 ordered chapters (spit/spjimr/bakerhughes) with correct metrics (SPJIMR 7+/20+/3/5+ · BH 180+/100+/×2/0) and highlights; all 6 static assets 200. Frontend: header 'THE FILMOGRAPHY.' with crimson period, three equal poster cards side by side on desktop (501×600, Δwidth<0.02px), hover zooms image (transform 1.001 → 1.053), opening SPJIMR shows 4 metrics + 4 highlights, SPIT shows 3 meta items + no metrics/highlights block, Baker Hughes shows the correct metric values and 4 highlights. Backdrop uses blur(14px), cursor-dot stays at z-index 1002 above the panel. ESC/back-button/backdrop-click all close the panel and scroll position is restored exactly (diff=0). Keyboard: cards focus and open with Enter. 'LET'S MAKE SOMETHING HAPPEN' scrolls to the #contact footer; footer shows H./tagline, mailto href, LinkedIn + GitHub links with target=_blank rel='noopener noreferrer'. Mobile 390: cards stack 1-col (w=354, no overflow), detail panel 370×820 with 2-col metric grid.
critical_code_review_comments: Filmography.js: ChapterCard uses role='button' + tabIndex=0 + Enter/Space keydown handler — good a11y. onClick wraps e in closure, originRect captured correctly.

ChapterDetail.js: FLIP via animate top/left/width/height on fixed element; onAnimationComplete gates onClose only when closing=true — correctly prevents premature unmount. document.body.style.overflow is reset in cleanup — scroll preserved (verified diff=0).
ContactFooter.js: mailto + external links correctly use rel='noopener noreferrer' and target='_blank'. No a11y issue.
Backend /api/filmography: excludes _id via projection ({_id:0}) and sorts by order — clean. No MongoDB _id leaked in payload (verified).

Minor: ChapterDetail recomputes target in useMemo([]) but doesn't recompute on resize — rotation/resize while a detail is open would leave stale target dimensions. Not in scope of current tests but worth noting.
